source: MITRE Center for Threat-Informed Defense — Fight Fraud Framework (F3)

tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.description: Adversary gathers information to plan fraud operations

techniques.name: Account Enumeration
techniques.description: Automated probing of account existence via login/payment APIs

techniques.name: BIN Attack / Card Testing
techniques.description: Rapid small-value transactions to validate stolen card numbers

tactics.name: Access Acquisition
tactics.description: Adversary gains unauthorized access to payment accounts or infrastructure

techniques.name: Credential Stuffing / Account Takeover
techniques.description: Automated login attempts using breached credential lists, leading to session hijack

techniques.name: Deepfake KYC Bypass
techniques.description: AI-generated documents or face videos to pass automated KYC verification

techniques.name: Synthetic Identity Creation
techniques.description: Fabricated identity combining real and fake PII to create new accounts

tactics.name: Positioning
tactics.description: Post-compromise data collection and lateral movement within payment networks

techniques.name: Mule Network Setup
techniques.description: Creating a coordinated network of accounts for layered fund transfers

techniques.name: Sleeper Mule Activation
techniques.description: Dormant accounts with legitimate history suddenly used for fraudulent transfers

techniques.name: Device Farm / Emulator Ring
techniques.description: Multiple accounts operated from shared device emulators or device farms

techniques.name: Collusive Merchant Setup
techniques.description: Fake or complicit merchants created to process fraudulent transactions

tactics.name: Monetization
tactics.description: Converting compromised assets into usable monetary value

techniques.name: CNP Rapid Cashout
techniques.description: Card-not-present transactions at high velocity to extract value before detection

techniques.name: Low-and-Slow Drain
techniques.description: Small, regular transactions designed to stay below velocity and amount thresholds

techniques.name: Refund / Chargeback Abuse
techniques.description: Legitimate purchases followed by fraudulent refund claims or chargeback disputes

techniques.name: Mule Network Cash-Out
techniques.description: Coordinated P2P transfers across mule accounts to launder and extract funds

tactics.name: Evasion
tactics.description: Techniques to avoid detection by fraud prevention systems

techniques.name: Anti-Fingerprinting / Signal Suppression
techniques.description: Tools that deliberately null device fingerprints, spoof geo, or mask IP to defeat device-based detection

techniques.name: Semantic Smuggling / NLP Evasion
techniques.description: Crafting transaction memos and descriptions to avoid NLP-based AML keyword filters

techniques.name: Impossible Travel Masking
techniques.description: Using VPNs or geo-spoofing to create plausible location history despite rapid movement

tactics.name: Agentic Exploitation
tactics.description: Attacks targeting autonomous payment agents and delegated authentication

techniques.name: Agentic Token Hijacking
techniques.description: Compromising delegated payment tokens used by autonomous commerce agents

techniques.name: Prompt Injection Payment Redirect
techniques.description: Injecting instructions into AI agent contexts to redirect payments to attacker-controlled accounts
